questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It tells drivers they must obey the law it displays. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate hazards ahead. This sign warns drivers to slow down for a sharp change in road direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead makes an extreme curve in the direction shown. Slow down as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow triangle with black lettering that marks a no passing zone. It appears on the left side of a two-lane road where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic rules you must obey. This sign tells drivers the direction they must travel on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: The road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: These parking spaces are reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road will make a sharp turn to the right, then a sharp turn to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look in all directions before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles frequently cross or travel beside the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Do not cross until any trains have passed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign tells you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead has limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has multiple curves. Adjust your speed to match the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.
